about: Words for the Downscale a WRF or ArWen run (3D) screen and the plain lines gpuwm-cm1 chain check prints. {name} fields are filled with numbers.

screen.title: Downscale a WRF or ArWen run (3D)
screen.lead: A finer GM1 domain inside your WRF or ArWen run: it starts from one saved time of your run, and its four sides follow the saved times after it.
screen.verified_hint: GM1-ARWEN-CHAIN.md sections 8 and 9, in the records folder installed with gpuwm-cm1 (cm1core/records)
screen.example: An ArWen run of the atmospheric river of 25 December 2025 over California: 3 km cells, P3 microphysics, saved hourly. A box of 36 x 66 of its cells over the ocean, from cell (6, 40), finer by 3, water vapour only with Morrison, 01:00 to 03:00 UTC: 108 x 198 GM1 cells of 1015 m on the ground. It ran 2 h in 87 s on an RTX 3080. GM1 made its own clouds within 30 min, and inside the relaxed rows it kept its air and water to 0.02 %. Idealized physics in a real-weather box, not a reconstruction.
screen.example_hint: GM1-ARWEN-CHAIN.md section 9.2, in the records folder installed with gpuwm-cm1 (cm1core/records)
screen.limits: GM1 is flat, so the box must sit over flat ground. On a mapped run GM1 takes the cell size on the ground at the box, so the map scale must not change by more than 1% across it. Terrain is on the roadmap.
screen.column_route: For one column of your run as a storm's environment (flat, the same air everywhere), use New run, From a WRF or ArWen run.
screen.file_placeholder: a wrfout file, a folder of them, or a folder of extracted frames
screen.map_caption: Ground height of your run. Drag on the map to draw the box GM1 runs in; the grey edge is too close to your run's own sides.
screen.map_caption_flat: Your run is idealized: flat, no map. Drag on the map to draw the box GM1 runs in.
screen.box_cells: {ni} x {nj} of your run's cells, from cell ({i0}, {j0})
screen.ratio_help: GM1 cells per cell of your run, along each side: 3, 5, 7 or 9.
screen.admitted: Every check passes. GM1 can run this box.
screen.refused: {n} check(s) do not pass. Each line says why.
screen.estimate_line: {cells} cells of {dx} m, {steps} steps. About {gpu} GB on the GPU and {wall} on this card; {disk} GB of disk with its saved times.
screen.prepare_line: Preparing it reads your run and writes {prepare} beside the run.
screen.made: Made {name}. Check it and start it like any run.
screen.found_none: No wrfout files under the runs folder. Type the full path of a file or a folder of one domain's files.
screen.facts: {producer} run: {n} saved times, {first} to {last}, every {interval}. {nx} x {ny} cells of {dx}, {levels} levels, {projection}.
screen.facts_one: {producer} run: one saved time, {first}; downscaling needs two or more. {nx} x {ny} cells of {dx}, {levels} levels, {projection}.
screen.facts_scheme_ok: Microphysics {scheme}: GM1 runs the same scheme.
screen.facts_scheme_no: Microphysics {scheme}: GM1 does not run it, so only its water vapour can be taken (Moisture: water vapour only); clouds and rain then form in GM1.
screen.map_legend_updraft: Orange: updrafts of 5 m/s or more (ground-relative) at the time shown.
screen.box_hint: Drag on the map, or type the first cell and the size.
screen.grid_line: GM1 grid: {nx} x {ny} cells of {dx} m, {km_x} x {km_y} km.
screen.make_needs_check: Check the box first; Make the run is on once every check passes.
screen.making: Preparing the box from your run. This reads every saved time and can take a minute.
screen.moisture_help: Water vapour only is WRF's own default for real-data runs: clouds and rain start at zero and form in GM1. It is the only choice when GM1 does not run your run's scheme.
screen.scheme_help: With water vapour only, GM1 can run WSM6 or Morrison whatever your run used.
screen.grid_line_scaled: GM1 grid: {nx} x {ny} cells of about {dx} m on the ground (map scale about {scale}), {km_x} x {km_y} km.
screen.grid_line_checked: GM1 grid: {nx} x {ny} cells of {dx} m on the ground (the box's map scale {scale}, as checked), {km_x} x {km_y} km.

frame_count.label: At least two saved times
frame_count.refused: Only {n} saved time: the sides need a later time to move toward.

frame_grid.label: Every saved time from one grid
frame_grid.pass: One grid, one scheme, one ground
frame_grid.refused: The saved times do not share one grid or microphysics scheme.
frame_grid.refused_ground: The ground height changes by up to {dhgt} m between {t0} and {t1}, so heights above ground would move. If only the first saved time differs, start at the next one.

cadence.label: Evenly spaced saved times
cadence.refused: The saved times are not evenly spaced, so the sides would move at uneven rates.

window.label: Start and end are saved times
window.refused: The start or end is not one of the saved times.

interval_step.label: Time step fits between saved times
interval_step.pass: {steps} steps of {dt} s between saved times
interval_step.refused: The GM1 time step does not divide the time between saved times.

duration.label: The run stays inside the saved times
duration.refused: The run would go past the last saved time.

projection.label: A grid GM1 can use
projection.refused: {projection}: GM1 needs square cells on a Lambert, polar, Mercator or idealized grid.

placement.label: The box sits inside your domain
placement.pass: At least 3 cells from every side
placement.refused: The box is closer than 3 cells to your run's own sides, or does not cover whole cells.

spacing.label: GM1 cells nest exactly
spacing.pass: {ratio} GM1 cells of {cell_m} m per cell of your run, on the ground
spacing.refused: GM1's cell size is not your run's cell size on the ground divided by the ratio.

terrain.label: Flat ground
terrain.refused: Ground varies by {relief} m, over the {limit} m limit. GM1 is flat and would leave the hills out. Move the box over flatter ground or water.

map_factor.label: Map scale even over the box
map_factor.pass: GM1 takes your run's cell size on the ground here (map scale {scale}); the scale changes by {departure}% across the box (limit {limit}%)
map_factor.pass_unit: No map scale to take: your run is flat and has no map
map_factor.refused: The map scale changes by {departure}% across the box, over the {limit}% limit, so some GM1 lengths would be off by that much. Make the box smaller.

coriolis.label: Earth's rotation matches
coriolis.refused: GM1's rotation does not match your run's at the box centre.

microphysics.label: Microphysics GM1 has
microphysics.pass: {scheme} in your run, the same scheme in GM1
microphysics.refused: Your run used {scheme}. GM1 downscales every cloud and rain field only from WSM6 (6), Thompson (8) and Morrison (10) runs; its water vapour alone can be taken (Moisture: water vapour only, or --moisture vapour-only).
microphysics.pass_vapour: Your run used {scheme}. GM1 runs {gm1_scheme} and takes only your run's water vapour: its clouds and rain start at zero and form in GM1

species.label: Every cloud and rain field saved
species.refused: Your run did not save {missing}, which this microphysics scheme carries.

variables.label: Every field the downscaling needs
variables.refused: Your run did not save {missing}, which the downscaling needs.

theta_m.label: Temperature saved as dry theta
theta_m.refused: The saved temperature includes moisture, so GM1 would start moist air too warm.
theta_m.refused_no_thm: Your run says its temperature is moist theta (use_theta_m = 1) but did not save THM beside T, so GM1 cannot confirm T is dry theta. Save THM, or run with use_theta_m = 0.

model_top.label: Your run reaches GM1's top
model_top.pass: Your run's top is above GM1's
model_top.refused: GM1's top is above your run's; lower GM1's top.

crossing.label: Saved often enough
crossing.pass: The fastest wind crosses the box in {crossing}; saved every {interval}
crossing.refused: The fastest wind crosses the box in {crossing}, sooner than the {interval} between saved times: air could enter and leave unseen. Save more often, or draw a bigger box.

checks.not_checked: Not checked until the {after} check passes.

rotation.none: No rotation, as in your run
